= Signalsmith Stretch (vendored)

Header-only sources used by `rivu-audio` for pitch-preserving playback speed.

* `signalsmith-stretch.h`: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch[Signalsmith Stretch]
  `main` at `88061fd` (1.4.0 with the Linear 0.6.6 pin), MIT
* `signalsmith-linear/{fft,stft}.h`: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear[Signalsmith Linear]
  tag `0.6.6`, MIT

Copied unmodified from the upstream repositories; only the headers reachable from
`signalsmith-stretch.h` are kept. Linear's root-level headers are the include
targets, not its `include/` forwarding copies.
